svg.title: GYNECAIRE current system flow - repository audit
svg.desc: Four matching editable draw.io pages arranged as a two-by-two atlas: trust boundaries, mobile onboarding and routing, verification linking, and staff workflows. E means source wiring, not deployed proof. Other statuses distinguish partial, UI-only, absent, and runtime-unknown features.

text.tspan: 01 Trust boundaries and the actual data path
Source audit only - 29 October 2026 - E means wired in repository, not verified in deployment.
Validate inputs where defined; parameterized SQL
Direct pg connection; not user-JWT PostgREST
Mobile .env.local has Supabase URL/public key only.
EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL and AUTH_REDIRECT_URL are absent there.
Account data and recovery are blocked unless supplied externally.
[U] RLS IS NOT THE SAME AS EXPRESS AUTHORIZATION
Only an own-profile SELECT client policy is represented.
API pg connections do not SET ROLE or forward request.jwt.claims.
Effective DB role, grants, BYPASSRLS and applied migrations are unknown.
No remote service/database was queried. A04; D07-D10
[E] PUBLIC DOES NOT MEAN A PUBLIC CLINIC DATA API
Education / clinic links bypass Express. The API public endpoint is health only.
Medical documents, inventory, community posting and scheduling services are absent.
Detailed mobile flow: page 2. Verification: page 3. Staff modules: page 4.
Solid arrows: wired control/data flow. Dashed arrows: user/manual or conditional progression.
All E paths still require their stated external prerequisites.
02 Mobile onboarding, account routing, and available features
MOBILE DETAIL - signup intent affects navigation only; all new Auth profiles start as general.
or create an account / sign in
No session: confirm email on initiating device
Clinic intent is not automatically resumed
Name, profile type, interests, latest status
Patient tabs: Home / Records / Visits / Learn / Profile
GET /care additionally requires linked own patient
Visits read-only; Records UI; monitoring absent
Notice to use staff web portal
No clinic role granted by password change
[U] Errors return to retry/status UI; callback failure does not complete signup/recovery.
API 401 signs out locally; missing local API URL prevents account/preferences/verification/care reads.
Public browsing still works. Patient tabs are navigation guards, not database authorization. M09, M13, M14
Solid arrows: wired control/data flow. Dashed arrows: user/manual or conditional progression.
All E paths still require their stated external prerequisites.
03 Patient verification, approval, rejection, and linking
THREE-BOUNDARY DETAIL - staff identity checking is manual; approval preserves the existing Auth identity.
No: insert pending intake + consent timestamp
Historical pending duplicates are not removed
Keep general access; no patient records
No automatic push or phone contact
Staff checks identity outside the app
Find and select an unlinked clinic record
New patient: create clinic record first
Lock pending request, recheck active staff,
lock applicant profile; require general account
Approval checks selected record is claimable
Only if general and no pending exists
All writes above are in transactions; role/grants/applied schema not checked at runtime.
Care uses patient type + linkage, NOT a separate approved-verification-row lookup.
Solid arrows: wired control/data flow. Dashed arrows: user/manual or conditional progression.
All E paths still require their stated external prerequisites.
04 Staff/admin workflows, API coverage, and explicit gaps
STAFF DETAIL - all supported active roles share operations except the admin-only read-only member directory.
Low stock is unavailable, not zero
Direct Auth call, not Express write
Create pending; staff enters Manila time
Clinic record creation does NOT create Auth user
Any supported transition allowed while nonfinal
Audit action only, not before/after history
Maximum 366 days; SQL counts, zero months filled
Navigable or disabled previews; NO clinical or stock persistence
[P] Assistant is an in-memory scripted administrative guide, NOT live AI
W14-W16, W19; no module API or migration
[A] Patient booking / slots, monitoring, clinical documents, stock adjustments, push delivery,
staff invite/role changes/deactivation, first-admin provisioning, patient archive, rejection reasons
No operational path found in the inspected routes and migrations.
Solid arrows: wired control/data flow. Dashed arrows: user/manual or conditional progression.
All E paths still require their stated external prerequisites.
